seeded: Seeded by hand on 2026-10-27 from the column names the kit's own information_schema queries use, docs/LESSONS.md and the fake. It carries no live column list: columns beyond the kit's queries are the standard names and must be confirmed. Regenerate it with s2rebuild engine-capture --fixture-database NAME on a live workspace; that run fills captured and clears this field.

show_aggregates.note: not seeded; s2rebuild engine-capture --fixture-database NAME reads the column names of SHOW AGGREGATES in that database

password_variables.note: GLOBAL_VARIABLES PASSWORD_% holds the workspace password policy (fact 20); the values are per workspace and are filled by a live capture

runner_versus_owner.note: facts 10 and 21: an account without routine or pipeline privileges sees no rows in ROUTINES or PIPELINES; the owner sees them all

syntax_forms.detached: ATTACH DATABASE `<name>` AT MILESTONE '<YYYY-MM-DD HH_MM_SS.ffffff>' STORAGEID <storage_id> COMPUTEID <compute_id>

attach.read_only_position: READ ONLY follows the names and comes before AT MILESTONE, STORAGEID and COMPUTEID; after STORAGEID it is error 1064
attach.note: ATTACH ... AS from a detached record adds a resume row and leaves the old row detached; from an attached database it adds a pitr row with a new COMPUTE_ID and leaves the old row attached; a detached record re-attaches by its own ATTACH_SYNTAX; ROW_NUMBER is not stable between listings

1064.when: a wrong ATTACH form: a quoted STORAGEID, or READ ONLY after STORAGEID
1064.message: You have an error in your SQL syntax; check the manual that corresponds to your MySQL server version for the right syntax to use near 'READ ONLY' at line 1
1064.source: fake, from the live run of October 26, 2026

1144.when: CREATE USER with a password that misses the workspace password policy (PASSWORD_% variables)
1144.message: The password does not satisfy the password policy
1144.source: kit wording from fact 20; confirm the text live

1205.when: an INSERT or DELETE waits past lock_wait_timeout on a leaf table lock
1205.message: Lock wait timeout exceeded; try restarting transaction

1227.when: CREATE VIEW with a DEFINER other than the executing account
1227.message: Access denied; you need (at least one of) the SUPER privilege(s) for this operation
1227.source: fake, from the live run of October 27, 2026

1290.when: a write on a READ ONLY attachment (the O3 write probe expects it)
1290.message: The database is attached read only

1836.when: a write on a READ ONLY attachment, the second number the server uses for it

1749.when: ALTER TABLE ... AUTO_INCREMENT = N on a sharded table
1749.message: Forwarding Error (node-master-0:3306): Feature 'ALTER TABLE...AUTO_INCREMENT=X for sharded tables' is not supported by SingleStore Distributed.
1749.source: fake, from the live run of October 27, 2026

1777.when: an INSERT into a reference table that reads a READ ONLY source
1777.message: Forwarding Error (node-master-0:3306): Partitions of <db> has no master instance. This is likely because the node or nodes that hold a copy of the partition are down.
1777.source: fake, from the live run of October 27, 2026

1997.when: a chunk in flight while autoscale replaces a node
1997.message: Transaction was already in its commit phase
1997.source: LESSONS fact 30 (work order appendix), wording from the log

2720.when: DROP DATABASE of a READ ONLY attachment; detach it and attach it read write first
2720.message: Cannot drop a database that is attached read only
2720.source: kit wording from fact 39; confirm the text live

2003.when: the server is unreachable as a session opens

2004.when: the client cannot create a socket

2006.when: the connection was closed by the server between two statements

2013.when: the connection dropped during a statement (the kit cannot tell whether it was applied)
2013.message: Lost connection to MySQL server during query
